s1.syndrome_frame: Tooth pain with abnormal root canal morphology and periapical radiolucency
salient_findings: Spontaneous dull pain during root canal therapy
Tender response to percussion
No response to cold or electric pulp tests
Periapical radiolucency at apex of DB root
C-shaped canal morphology in P root
key_facts: Patient is a 26-year-old female
Referred for root canal retreatment of tooth #17
Tooth sealed with temporary filling material
Tender in response to percussion
No response to cold or electric pulp tests
Radiopaque filling material visible in coronal third of canal
Periapical radiolucency present at apex of DB root
C-shaped canal morphology in P root
Two different canal orifices in coronal third of P canal
Canals joined to form C-shaped ribbon-like pattern in middle third
Two P canals joined to one foramen in apical part
